set.body: Current main preserves expected-unmatched pairing in the library, but the native UI projection is incomplete. RealPreview.initial always sets candidates.byDesignQueries=None; Eligibility has no by-design case; DesignFilter.admits has no ByDesign match and explicitly says no backend row is by design yet. RealPreviewCursorSuite by-design tests inspect configured.work/reasons, not the actual service receipt/rows. This is a display/count classification gap, not evidence that lures are being paired: library expected-unmatched pairing tests already pass. Serve the library classification in native preview and completed query rows, keep by-design distinct from data-error no-match in count strips/filters/inspector, and add mixed-cohort API-to-UI tests including item-ID collisions and no guessed references. Preserve correct initial counting semantics and update the coordinated protocol. Found during owner-approved priorities1-5; G3 must not close on the library-only tests.
set.title: Native preview/results: carry by-design classification through query counts and filters
